text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: spike in 5xx errors and timeouts for /v1/generate -> gateway (elevated error rate 18% over baseline). Affected region: us-west-2. Paging oncall@eng-sre. thread_ts=5299994321

Ada: seeing it on dashboards now, latency up, lots of 502/504s. Customers reporting timeouts.

Sanjay: logs show model-runner processes segfaulting on a subset of requests, then OOMs on the same hosts. stack traces point at native kernel alloc path.

Maria: is this the KV cache path we patched last week? could be related.

Ada: maybe. reproducer attached by one customer shows long context windows triggering a big KV spike. Not all models, mostly longseq-encoder models.

Josh: paging summary for quick context: traffic spike + some long-context requests => model runner memory blowout on 3 nodes -> autoscaler didn't replace fast enough -> gateway 5xx.

Claire: are fallbacks configured? can we route to a quantized variant to reduce mem pressure?

Sanjay: fallback policy is enabled but seems not kicking in because requests hit same hot shard. Need immediate manual reroute.

Ada: I'll flip routing rule to prefer model_variant=redwood-gpt-3.5-q75 in us-west-2 for 10m. doing it now: /ops/reroute --svc=inference-gateway --region=us-west-2 --prefer-variant=redwood-gpt-3.5-q75 --duration=10m

deploy-bot: command accepted — routing change queued.

Ada: routing change applied. traffic to quant variant up to 60% in 30s. error rate dropped to ~6% but still elevated.

Sanjay: I'm SSHing into the node with repeated segfaults: host ip 10.2.14.9. grabbing dmesg and core dumps.

Sanjay: dmesg excerpt:
```
[5498123.123456] model_runner[7423]: segfault at 0 ip 0x7f8b2a1c4f3b sp 0x7ffc3a1b0e58 error 4 in libattention.so[7f8b29f00000+1a000]
[5498123.124000] Out of memory: Kill process 7423 (model_runner) score 987 or sacrifice child
```

Maria: hmm kernel OOM killer invoked. likely not leak but a request pattern that allocs big contiguous buffers. Could be a new attention kernel path for longkeys.

Josh: For immediate mitigation, we can cordon and drain the three affected nodes to avoid repeated OOMs and let autoscaler spin new nodes. Also increase pod eviction threshold to reduce cascade.

Ada: comms note: sending small message to #support-ops and CSMs to inform impacted customers of degraded performance and mitigation steps.

Claire: doing drain on node-ids: i-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h, i-0b1c2d3e4f5g6h7i, i-0c1d2e3f4g5h6i7j

Sanjay: while draining, I captured a minimal reproducer request body from customer X that triggers the crash. uploading to /tmp/repro-529999.json.

Sanjay: repro snippet:
```
{"prompt": "<very long context ... 120k tokens>", "model": "longseq-encoder-v2", "max_tokens": 2048}
```

Maria: ok I'm going to disable the new longkv kernel path for longseq-encoder-v2 via runtime flags so we go back to stable allocator. patching configmap runtime-optimizations -> set LONGKV_KERNEL=off for longseq-encoder-v2.

deploy-bot: rolling restart initiated for runtime-pool-longseq-encoder-v2 (3 pods) with env update LONGKV_KERNEL=off.

Ada: restart progress: pod1 restarted ok, pod2 still terminating, pod3 crashlooping (OOM at startup).

Josh: if pod3 keeps crashlooping, we should evict and schedule in a fresh host with larger ephemeral memory. I've requested one larger instance from infra (g4dn.xlarge -> g4dn.2xlarge).

Claire: infra confirmed capacity; new hosts provisioning. ETA ~3m.

Ada: error rate down to 3.1% after routing + partial restarts. Customer timeouts largely reduced. Still keeping pager.

Sanjay: collected core, will start a gdb backtrace to confirm faulty kernel function. For now marking runtime flagged and enabling stricter request size guard at gateway: reject >80k token contexts with 413 and guidance to chunk. Patching gateway rule now.

Ada: patched gateway -> added request_size_limit=80k tokens for longseq-encoder-v2 in us-west-2. Will roll globally if stable.

Maria: moving to post-incident actions: 1) revert longkv kernel commit from canary branches, 2) add integration test with 100k token synthetic load, 3) tune autoscaler thresholds, 4) implement proactive fallback triggering when node-level oom rate > 5/min.

Josh: agree. Also add customer-facing postmortem draft and update status page.

oncall-rotation: oncall handover reminder: @Sanjay you have the pager til 04:00 UTC, @Ada please leave notes in the incident doc.

Ada: will add notes and handoff. Thanks everyone — keeping thread open until full postmortem items are assigned and runtime is stabilized. :thumbsup:

Claire: quick todo assigned in #incidents-runbooks: reproduce -> root-cause -> deploy hotfix -> run long regression tests.

incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated, severity=high -> monitoring for 30m.

Ada: last check — error rate steady at ~0.8% and gateways healthy. closing active mitigation but keeping a follow-up runbook.
